scenes.setting: The gathering winds down: nobody has the Black Widow gland (Klein resists tailing the male buyer of a Demoness ingredient), and the Apothecary sells out his medicines in three minutes

Prepared at last, into 32 Verdi Street at night: a strangled burglar's ghost-theater loops the staircase — until Azik's whistle is thrown as bait and one pale-gold purifying bullet burns the wraith away ('Bye bye'); the basement holds the brown notebook from the divination dream
scenes.text_anchor: The pale gold purifying bullet flew out and accurately hit that cold and indistinct object.
